newsitem.title: INDIA: India Siemens says to hike share capital.
newsitem.headline: India Siemens says to hike share capital.

text.p: Siemens India Ltd, a unit of Germany's Siemens AG, said on Friday it planned to raise its share capital and expected to make an announcement within four weeks.

"The share capital is something we are currently reviewing," managing director Juergen Schubert told reporters after announcing that the firm had suffered an 845-million-rupee loss in the 12 months to March 31, 1997.
"It is too early to speculate in public," Schubert added. "We have to align with our largest shareholder and align with our board. We expect to make an announcement in four weeks."
Analysts had earlier estimated Siemens' loss at 450 million rupees.

Siemens attributed the loss to the discontinuation of its telecommunications operations which are being transferred to a new company, Siemens Public Communications Networks Ltd as well as to the cost of restructuring its business operations.
In addition, the operations of its main business had deteriorated due to higher operational costs, lower capacity utilisation, higher interest and risk burden.
